at commit f83fbdd4ee1c07e1afa52694963f3a9a889a0f56 (shallow clone; its own .git removed).
To restore the clone:  git clone https://github.com/utiasDSL/gym-pybullet-drones vendor/gym-pybullet-drones

Local addition: gym_pybullet_drones/assets/f450.urdf (DIY F450 quadcopter, 1.5 kg; copy of cf2x.urdf with
F450 mass, inertia, arm, thrust constants). Used through drone_follow/f450.py; no library code is modified.
